title: KeyError while switching accounts (user.lookup)
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.0.3 on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS against us-east-1.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
* Start by switching accounts.
* Use the customer file with the missing column (sample attached).
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

Expected switching accounts to finish without errors.

## Actual

It fails on a field absent from the input; the file has no such column. A
customer file with a missing column was accepted without any validation.

## Frequency

Happens only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:47 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:127 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:61 in start
lattice/auth/user.py:214 in lookup
KeyError: 'display_name'
